answer_1.quote: We release a new benchmark dataset, NLEBench, for the purpose of evaluating generative language modelling in Norwegian.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated responses in dialogue, summaries, answers to questions, and instruction-following outputs in Norwegian.

answer_2.quote: We aim to comprehensively evaluate our models across various tasks using widely used metrics for NLP tasks, including BLEU, ROUGE, Distinct, and MAUVE...

answer_3.quote: To facilitate the annotation process, we developed an API, shown in Figure, that can connect with the OpenAI GPT-4 model to suggest annotations.

answer_4.quote: We recruited three Norwegian native speakers, all of whom are college students, to independently score the Adequacy and Fluency of each text.
answer_4.guideline: Adequacy measures whether the translated text accurately conveys the meaning of the original text, while Fluency assesses whether the expression of the translated text aligns with native Norwegian expressions.
